# Steinheim Suite

> Steinheim Suite is an integrated business management platform for invoicing, live inventory, customers, call center, shipping, and reporting — built for premium teams and distributors.

Steinheim Suite unifies smart invoices, QR/barcode selling, live stock and low-stock alerts, customer CRM with balances, distributor workflows, shipping orders, audit trail, biometric login, offline PWA operation, and role-based permissions in a single luxury, Arabic/English interface.
